Community & Relief

Work undertaken

Standing with the community when support matters most.

Community relief is where the Aashray journey began. From meals during the lockdown to food and clothing distribution, our early work responded to immediate needs through practical community participation.

ON THIS PAGE

Food supportClothing supportOur approachThe direction aheadOur Work

01 / Community & Relief

Food support

During the 2020 lockdown, Bharosa Group brought volunteers and participating families together to help people who needed food. The Roti Challenge gave households a weekly way to contribute, supported by the team’s collection, packing and distribution work.

Discover the Roti Challenge

02 / Community & Relief

Clothing support

Clothing distribution is also part of the work Aashray has undertaken. This reflects the same purpose as our food initiatives: responding to everyday needs with care and respect.

03 / Community & Relief

Our approach

Relief is about people as much as supplies. We seek to keep dignity at the centre of community support and value the contributions of families, volunteers and supporters who make collective action possible.

04 / Community & Relief

The direction ahead

As the foundation grows, this pillar will continue to guide our response to community needs. Future activities will be shared with confirmed details, so supporters can understand what is needed and how to participate.
